CAP Federal, State, or Local Incarceration are arrests made while the person was in criminal custody of a federal/state prison or a local jail.

Pending criminal charge means an individual was charged with, but not convicted of a crime. [...] In 2024, ICE apprehended 45 people with only a pending criminal charge, while in 2025 (through October), they apprehended 319 people with only a pending criminal charge. This is a 600% increase.
